identity.name: Copperwood Tavern
identity.notes: The canonical record binds unambiguously to the active single Arlington/Shirlington restaurant. All sibling or out-of-scope locations are excluded.

sources.excerpt: Current first-party home page identifies Copperwood Tavern at 4021 Campbell Ave, Arlington, VA 22206, lists active hours and contact details, and offers dine-in, takeout, delivery, reservations, catering, and ordering.
Current first-party menu hub links Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Kids Brunch, Dessert, Drinks, Happy Hour, and Kids Lunch + Dinner menus for the single Arlington location.

Live Arlington online ordering menu at 4021 Campbell Ave was inventoried across every visible weekday category, including starters, entrees, sandwiches, sides, salads/soups, desserts, kids, and NA beverages.

Fresh current weekend crawl of the same exact-location online menu exposed the complete brunch service, including starters, omelettes, benedicts, entrees, sandwiches, soup/salad, sides, desserts, NA beverages, and kids brunch.
Current Owner-hosted Lunch Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely; direct positive ingredients are retained for exact products.
Current Owner-hosted Dinner Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely; bundled wine was excluded.
Current Owner-hosted Happy Hour Menu was inventoried completely for food; alcohol and drink discounts were excluded.
Current Owner-hosted Kids Lunch + Dinner Menu was inventoried completely.
Current Owner-hosted Kids Brunch Menu was inventoried completely with explicit ingredient positives retained.

The dietary-restrictions FAQ says the restaurant will make its best attempt to accommodate dietary restrictions and directs guests to call for specific requests; it is not an allergen matrix or safety guarantee.
Current two-page Owner-hosted Brunch Menu from the live first-party hub was inventoried completely. Alcohol was excluded; food and six nonalcoholic cold-brew/tea products were retained.
Current image-based Owner-hosted Dessert Menu was rendered and visually inventoried completely. Six desserts were retained and three alcoholic libations excluded.
Current Owner-hosted Drinks Menu was inventoried completely for nonalcoholic scope: four N/A cocktails, Heineken 0.0, and Athletic Hazy IPA were retained.
The official menu hub links this Copperwood app. Fresh inspection/search found no product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact policy beyond the first-party menu catalog.
Fresh official-domain document searches returned current menus but no product-by-allergen matrix, ingredient guide, nutrition guide, or cross-contact document.
Fresh exact-brand and exact-location targeted searches found the official menus and catering FAQ but no additional authoritative allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.

findings.summary: The record binds exactly to the open Arlington/Shirlington location at 4021 Campbell Ave.
Ten complete exact-location surfaces yield 152 unique current food and nonalcoholic products after service-period alias consolidation, Brussels duplicate collapse, and alcohol exclusion.
One frozen entree is stale; nine fee, flavor-modifier, or recurring-event labels are non-product artifacts. Brussels Sprouts presentations collapse to one canonical product.

All four searches found no matrix or cross-contact policy; 85 products retain explicit restaurant-issued positive ingredient evidence and all remaining products are unavailable without negative inference.
